name: BioMCP runtime bootstrap via skill
purpose: L1 side-effect case: the agent bootstraps the project-local BioMCP runtime in the disposable run directory in non-interactive mode; mutates run dir only.
prompt: Run the bioresearcher-onboard skill to bootstrap the project-local BioMCP runtime in the current working directory in non-interactive mode. Locate the bootstrap script in the skill's base directory (under .opencode/skills/bioresearcher-onboard/scripts/bootstrap.sh) and execute it. Skip optional features (do not enable R analysis, Biowasm, or MySQL). Do not ask any clarifying questions.
